inputs.note: MODE: the real supervisor, in process — run_ask_turn with chart, document store, retriever and drafter injected. No network, no model. Harness fakes come from tests/w2_graph_support.py, which is NOT gated; the gate asserts only on the graph's own output and each check carries a control. Sample: the factory's med_discrepancy scenario (form says amLODIPine 10 MG, chart product is 2.5 MG).

expected: A form that disagrees with the chart surfaces the disagreement, carries no resolution, claims no change to the chart, and cannot have written one — the ask path references no write-back at all.
guards_against: A silent overwrite of a clinician's record by a patient's recollection, and its mirror: a disagreement dropped instead of shown.
